prompt:
Create pixel-art pieces for a modern 16-bit-style top-down RPG town map (three-quarter overhead view, like a classic SNES JRPG town).

Image 1 is a PLACEMENT GUIDE on a magenta page: fill each grey box edge to edge with the piece described for it. Do not copy the grey colour.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: the approved walking sprite of a character from this game at the same pixel scale as the map (about 90 sprite pixels tall). Match its sprite-pixel size, its outlines and its flat 2-3 tone shading with light from the upper left.

Image 3 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.
Image 4 is approved art from this same game map: match its colours, outline weight and shading exactly.

Pieces:
- the top-left box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). the floor of an ancient ruined temple seen from above: large dark grey-blue cracked flagstones with moss in the joints and a few small pebbles, evenly spread.
- the top-right box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). broken ruined temple floor seen from above: cracked dark stone slabs with scattered rubble, loose stones and patches of dark earth, evenly spread.
- the middle-left box (96x48 sprite pixels): a strip that repeats SEAMLESSLY left to right (its top and bottom edges are real edges). the inside wall of an ancient temple seen from the front: big dark grey-blue weathered stone blocks with deep joints, a worn carved frieze along the top edge and a darker base along the bottom edge, some cracks and moss.
- the middle-right box (96x96 sprite pixels): a SEAMLESS texture (left edge continues into the right edge, top into bottom). the top of thick ancient dark stone walls seen from straight above: rough dark grey-blue stone with cracks and moss, darker than the floor, evenly spread.

Draw each piece as one continuous picture with no lines dividing it into squares. Render as true pixel art: every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients, no blur. Between the boxes: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF), no text.
